generalMessage: Hi! I saw your Late Night Lab catalog and wanted to ask about your kits.

products.name: ESP32 Starter Kit
products.desc: ESP32 dev board, breadboard, jumper wires and a couple of sensors to get you from unboxing to blinking LED in one sitting.

products.name: Line-Following Bot
products.desc: Chassis, motors, IR sensors and driver board pre-wired — solder-free assembly, code included and explained.

products.name: Soldering Practice Kit
products.desc: A forgiving PCB, extra components and a short guide — built for your first (or fiftieth) clean joint.

products.name: Temp & Humidity Node
products.desc: A small sensor node that logs readings to your laptop over serial — good base for a mini weather project.

products.name: LED Matrix Display
products.desc: 8x8 driven matrix with a starter library so you can scroll text or draw pixel art within the hour.

products.name: Custom Build
products.desc: Have something specific in mind? Tell me what you're trying to build and I'll quote parts and time.
